analytics.clicks_sub: Link taps from people who don't have the app yet
analytics.deferred_opens_sub: First app open after a fresh install
analytics.matched_sub: Sent to the exact content the link pointed to
analytics.direct_opens_sub: Opened by users who already had the app
analytics.coverage_sub: Of new installs, how many we restored to the right content

analytics.timeseries_note: New installs (first app opens) vs Link restored — the gap is unrestored installs. Clicks are shown as volume context only.
